_comment: Omberg's own vegetation-generator rules: flags of each generator's script (server/services/vegetation-generators.ts, by source), passed by Update vegetation and `bun run grass:zones` before any CLI flags. Seeded from Vreta's: tall-grass (pipeline/grass_zones.py) thinned with distance from play (rough, semi, fairway, green, tee, bunker) for frame time (Marcus, 2026-10-14; VSP grass cost 0.4 ms at tee 1, 1.6 ms at the hole 4 tee view); Vreta since 2026-10-15: near 18/4/0.6, far 40/10/0.5 (0.6 from 20 m, 0.3 from 50 m). 2026-10-16 (Marcus): Omberg has far fewer trees than Vreta, so the VSP grass is 30 % thicker within 30 m of play (grass-palette.json: every rough_tall texture item's sampleDistance / sqrt(1.3)) with a longer, gentler falloff: the near rule falls over 30-45 m to 0.46 (= Vreta's 0.6 / 1.3, so beyond about 45 m the density is what it was), the far rule over 55-80 m to 0.5; the two multiply, 0.46 x 0.5 x 1.3 = 0.3 of the old full density from 80 m, Vreta's 0.3. The far mix (rough_tall/far, from 40 m) is not thinned. rock-shore (pipeline/rock_shore_zones.py, 2026-10-16): the rocky shore along Vättern at the 14th green; inland 0.4 since 2026-10-17 (Marcus: the 140 outcrops found in the lidar and ortho should blend in, not only the shore): every slab gets crack grass and heath, inland scrub and grass at 0.4 in a 4 m band.
zoneMaskResolution_comment: 2026-10-17 (Marcus): 2048 px masks (0.74 m/px on the 1510 m square) instead of gspro.py's 4096. The 32 masks are uncompressed RGBA textures in the GSPro bundle (64 MB each at 4096, about 2 GB); with the 14th-green rock slabs, roads and props the bundle's sharedAssets reached 4.21 GB, and Unity players load no serialized file over 4 GB (GreenKeeper: Error loading course). Zones feather over metres, so the coarser mask barely shows.
trees_comment: lidarSizeFactor (gspro.py trees --size-factor): every lidar stem's height and crown radius times this. Measured 2026-10-18 on 18 free-standing trees on open grass: their shadows in the summer ortho (orto-l2-2025, 2025-06-14 08:30-08:40 UTC, sun 46.4 deg up from 127 deg; height = shadow length x tan(elevation) + the DEM's rise to the tip) are 1.7 m taller (median, +14 %, all 18 taller, +0.2..+4.1 m) and their crowns 16 % wider than the lidar's (dsm-skoglig 22c009, flown 2022-03-13 leaf-off at about 1.6 pulses/m2: three summers of growth plus bare tops the pulses miss). Marcus 2026-10-18: the trees nearest the tee looked much bigger on video than in Unity. Photo stems keep their own size.
routing_comment: Who draws each tree, decided before planting (arborist.py route; moved here from arborist-species.json 2026-10-20). farBillboard: a tree both further than outsideOob outside the course boundary and further than fromPlay from the playing field (rough, semi, fairway, green, tee, bunker, wherever they lie) is an Arborist billboard, whatever its model; every tree inside the boundary is drawn by its own model's renderer. Marcus 2026-10-13: 40 m was too aggressive, 80 m. outerKeep (Marcus 2026-10-13): the horizon forest need not draw every tree, and less the further out: bands by distance outside the boundary [metres or null = beyond, share kept]; half of all outer billboards showed no difference in the forest wall from three viewpoints and no measurable frame-rate gain either. outerMinHeightM (Marcus 2026-10-21): the outer terrain plants no tree lower than 4 m - the smallest add nothing to the horizon, and a sapling model there broke the outer planting.
dark_comment: 2026-10-17 (Marcus: the brightened tall rough reads too light on the dark crop fields): tall-grass hands over to rough_tall/dark (and far to far_dark) where Unity's ground render (golfmap.surfaces.ground, linear luminance smoothed over 4 m) falls from 0.055 to 0.049. Measured in that render: deep rough on holes 1 and 5 0.056-0.064 (the brightened mix matches it), the crop field at Unity x 810-890, z 440-480 0.047-0.048, a pale meadow 0.066; the script's 0.056/0.046 left the crop field at 0.6-0.8 dark, with specks of the light mix.
